about: Findings of tools/guardian-scans.mjs that were examined and accepted. Each needs a reason. An exception whose finding no longer appears is reported as stale. Calvin PSA 119 (a volume title page and translator's preface) is deliberately NOT listed: it is a real defect awaiting repair.
